issues.description: Step-3 page.tsx has duplicate React hook imports causing a build error: 'useEffect' and 'useState' are defined multiple times
issues.root_cause: The file has two separate import lines from 'react' - one legacy line 'import { useState, useEffect } from react' and a second line 'import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from react', causing duplicate identifier errors in the SWC compiler

issues.description: Multiple hydration errors across pages - text content mismatch between server-rendered HTML and client
issues.root_cause: Server and client render different text content, likely due to dynamic values (e.g. step counter, QR code) being rendered differently on server vs client

issues.description: Step counter shows 'STEP 4 OF 4' but we are on step-6, suggesting either the header is hardcoded incorrectly or the step-6 page is reusing step-4's component/data
issues.root_cause: The step-6 page likely has a hardcoded step number or is sharing state/component with step-4

fixes.new_str:
"use client"
import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Remove the duplicate first import line that causes 'useState' and 'useEffect' to be defined multiple times, fixing the SWC build error

fixes.new_str:

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback, useRef } from "react";
fixes.reason: Alternative pattern match - remove duplicate import lines that cause build failure, consolidating into a single import statement
